title: Mod Toggler
description: A mod that allows enabling and disabling mods without removing their JAR files manually.
body:
# ❕️About this mod
This mod allows enabling and disabling mods without removing their JAR files manually. Currently supports 🦊️Neoforge 1.21.x
## ⚙️How it works
Mods are moved to/from a 'disabled' subfolder inside your mods directory.
Changes take effect after restarting Minecraft.
Open the GUI with the Mod Toggler button in the main menu.
## 🛠️Usage
- Enter the mod toggler menu using the **Mod Toggler button** in the game's main menu 
- All mods in the mods folder will appear in the menu with their names and versions
- If it can't detect the mod's name it will show the **mod's file name**
- If it can't detect the mod's version it will show **v?**
- Click unwanted/wanted mods to toggle them
- **Restart is required for changes to take affect**
### ⚠️Note
This mod isn't finished yet, but more updates and Minecraft version support are coming soon.
Please help us by reporting bugs on the **Report issues** link
